run_main_unroll_eval: run main_unroll_eval to evaluate model unrolling by comparing predicted states to ground truth MSE
run_main_eval: run main_eval to execute goal-conditioned planning episodes and log success rate and state distance
create_GCAgent: create a GCAgent with a JEPA model, planner config, normalizer, and environment for goal-conditioned planning
create_CEMPlanner: create a CEMPlanner that uses cross-entropy method to optimize action sequences minimizing representation distance to goal
create_MPPIPlanner: create an MPPIPlanner that uses model predictive path integral to sample and weight elite action trajectories
